# Tesla LoadPilot

> Local, cloud-free dynamic load management for the Tesla Wall Connector
> Gen 3, driven by the utility meter. Two ESP32 nodes emulate the Tesla
> (Neurio) reference meter on the charger's RS485 bus and feed it a shaped
> version of the real house measurements over an encrypted UDP link; a Home
> Assistant integration (HACS) observes, configures and orchestrates on
> top. The control law is firmware-resident: it survives Home Assistant,
> WiFi and cloud outages. One pilot site (France, three-phase 15 kVA,
> TWC firmware 26.18 calibration, revalidated on 26.26.1).

Key facts for any assistant working on this repo:

- The measured wallbox behaviour model is the core asset; never "improve"
  the control law without reading it first.
- The publication law lives in `esphome/packages/twc-core.yaml`; the HA
  integration in `custom_components/loadpilot/` never sits in the
  real-time loop.
- Firmware and integration are released in lockstep under one git tag;
  ESPHome `ref:` and HACS must install the same tag.
- Single-phase support is designed but THEORETICAL (never bench-validated).
- No Tesla imagery, no personal data of the site owner, attribution to
  PVi1/esphome-twc-control and LucaTNT is mandatory in emulation docs.

## Condensed knowledge

- [AI knowledge base](docs/AI_KNOWLEDGE.md): single self-contained English
  document with the architecture, the full publication law and all measured
  constants, the TWC behaviour model (dead band, distrust), the numbered
  lessons, the control patterns and the fr/en glossary. Read this first.

## Core documentation

- [README](README.md): pitch, hardware BOM, protection layers, quick start.
- [Measured TWC Gen 3 behaviour model](docs/en/BEHAVIOR.md): service loop,
  protection integral, plausibility, distrust state, validations
  (MEASURED / INFERRED / REPORTED labels).
- [Installation guide](docs/en/INSTALL.md): hardware, wiring, flashing,
  Tesla One commissioning, HACS, shadow-first test ladder.
- [Architecture decisions](ARCHITECTURE.md): product form, ESP/HA boundary,
  abstractions, versioning.
- [Team and interface contracts](CONTRACTS.md): entity contract, UDP
  contract, service contract (French).
- [Operator runbook](docs/en/RUNBOOK_INCIDENTS.md): incident signatures and
  responses.
- [Test plan](docs/en/TESTPLAN.md): validation campaign, GO/NO-GO criteria.
